appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Visitors at Three Train Stations in City Z'
Vertical axis labeled 'Number of Visitors', with tick marks from 1,000 to 4,500
Horizontal axis labeled 'Date', with tick marks for 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu'
Legend: blue = Station X, green = Station Y, orange = Station Z
Stacked bar for Tuesday: blue segment at ~1,300, green at ~2,000, orange at ~1,200, total ~4,500
Stacked bar for Wednesday: blue segment at ~1,300, green at ~1,200, orange at ~2,000, total ~4,500
Stacked bar for Thursday: blue segment at ~1,100, green at ~1,500, orange at ~1,800, total ~4,400
Stacked bar for Monday: blue segment at ~1,300, green at ~1,400, orange at ~1,300, total ~4,000
